            bca_jr_apply_inc_gears = { JOB = treasure_gatherer TARGET = bca_jr_target }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_quota_society_research value > 0 }
                bca_jr_should_inc_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_for_society_research = yes
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_raw_treasure_gatherer_gestalt value >= 1 }
                check_variable = { which = bca_jr_cooldown_full_treasure_gatherer_gestalt value <= 0 }
            }
            # target = min(acc_raw / 4, quota), 至少 50
            set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = bca_jr_acc_raw_treasure_gatherer_gestalt }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = 4 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_target value > bca_jr_quota_society_research }
                }
                set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = bca_jr_quota_society_research }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_target value < 50 }
                }
                set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = 50 }
            }
            # 消费配额
            subtract_variable = {
                which = bca_jr_quota_society_research
                value = bca_jr_target
            }
            # 清除对端冷却（增加岗位说明不再为空）
            clear_variable = bca_jr_cooldown_empty_treasure_gatherer_gestalt
            bca_jr_apply_inc_gears = { JOB = treasure_gatherer_gestalt TARGET = bca_jr_target }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_quota_society_research value > 0 }
                bca_jr_should_inc_wrangler_for_society_research = yes
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_raw_wrangler value >= 1 }
                check_variable = { which = bca_jr_cooldown_full_wrangler value <= 0 }
            }
            # target = min(acc_raw / 4, quota), 至少 50
            set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = bca_jr_acc_raw_wrangler }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = 4 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_target value > bca_jr_quota_society_research }
                }
                set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = bca_jr_quota_society_research }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_target value < 50 }
                }
                set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = 50 }
            }
            # 消费配额
            subtract_variable = {
                which = bca_jr_quota_society_research
                value = bca_jr_target
            }
            # 清除对端冷却（增加岗位说明不再为空）
            clear_variable = bca_jr_cooldown_empty_wrangler
            bca_jr_apply_inc_gears = { JOB = wrangler TARGET = bca_jr_target }
        }
    }

            # 清除对端冷却（减少岗位说明不再满）
            clear_variable = bca_jr_cooldown_full_turtle_miner_gestalt
            bca_jr_apply_dec_gears = { JOB = turtle_miner_gestalt TARGET = bca_jr_target }
        }
    }
    # ── dec wrangler ──
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            bca_jr_should_dec_wrangler = yes
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_cooldown_empty_wrangler value <= 0 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_raw_wrangler value >= 1 }
            }
            set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = bca_jr_acc_raw_wrangler }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = 4 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_target value < 50 }
                }
                set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = 50 }
            }
            # 清除对端冷却（减少岗位说明不再满）
            clear_variable = bca_jr_cooldown_full_wrangler
            bca_jr_apply_dec_gears = { JOB = wrangler TARGET = bca_jr_target }
        }
    }

    # ==== 清理临时变量 ====
    clear_variable = bca_jr_target
    clear_variable = bca_jr_quota_alloys
    clear_variable = bca_jr_quota_consumer_goods
    clear_variable = bca_jr_quota_energy
    clear_variable = bca_jr_quota_engineering_research
    clear_variable = bca_jr_quota_food
    clear_variable = bca_jr_quota_minerals
    clear_variable = bca_jr_quota_physics_research
    clear_variable = bca_jr_quota_society_research

}
